status: Prospective experiment targets, declared before full training and reserved-test evaluation; not production acceptance criteria
scope: Fresh focus-eight AI-generated contrast cases; model still predicts all 32 capabilities
semantic_metrics: Raw model with validation-selected semantic thresholds; no operational deferral
policy_metrics: Validation-selected policy, with required recall and in-scope coverage reported to prevent all-reject claims
test_rules: Freeze reserved bytes and AI review before full training.
Lock final weights, thresholds and policy on development data before parsing reserved prompts or labels.
Do not tune or retrain on the resulting reserved-test errors.
Report missed targets and all-32 extra predictions, not only focus-eight scores.
Keep all human_review fields pending until actual human review.

validation_selection_budget.first: Pinned official pretrained initialization, 35 epochs maximum
validation_selection_budget.optional_second: If first misses validation required F1 0.75 or forbidden F1 0.70, continue unchanged v2 weights for at most 25 epochs, encoder LR 2e-5, head LR 1e-4
validation_selection_budget.final_selection: Higher predeclared contrast score on validation only; fresh reserved test remains unopened until final selection
